springInstructions.beat1: Hands low and close to your body.
springInstructions.beat4: Bring your hands together in front of your chest.

winterInstructions.beat2: Cross your arms into a self-hug.
winterInstructions.beat4: Return upright and release your arms.

sequence.springInterludeDefault: Use the same four-part spring bloom.
sequence.winterIntroCold: Winter values show how strongly the body contracts.
sequence.winterIntroContract: Lower values mean a deeper cold contraction.
sequence.winterInterludeDefault: Use the same four-part winter contraction.
